data.name: Hero_Paragraph1
data.value: Our restaurant offers juicy grilled burgers, crispy fries, and refreshing milkshakes. Perfect for a family lunch, a quick dinner, or a snack with friends. Fresh ingredients, rich flavor, and fast service. Our rule: no compromise on quality!

data.name: Hero_Paragraph2
data.value: Welcome to the place where your new favorite burger is made. It's all about juicy beef, perfectly fried chicken, and the smoothest milkshakes. Try it and taste the difference!

data.name: Hero_Paragraph3
data.value: It's more than just food. We prepare every dish with care, use local ingredients, and believe that good food brings people together. Come for the flavor, stay for the atmosphere.

data.name: Dish_PizzaDescription
data.value: Pizza is always a good idea! And ours is even more so. We cook quickly and eat with pleasure. Order now!

data.name: About_Text
data.value: At Feane, we believe that real food is an art that brings people together. Our cuisine is a harmony of traditional recipes and modern trends, where every ingredient is carefully selected and every dish is prepared with a passion for taste and quality.
